mapper.sql: SELECT contract_id, contract_no, contract_name, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, contract_type, sign_date, effective_date, expire_date, contract_amount, paid_amount, payment_terms, delivery_terms, sign_by, sign_department, party_a, party_b, file_url, file_name, change_count, terminate_date, terminate_reason, del_flag, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_contract
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_contract ( contract_no, contract_name, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, contract_type, sign_date, effective_date, expire_date, contract_amount, paid_amount, payment_terms, delivery_terms, sign_by, sign_department, party_a, party_b, file_url, file_name, change_count, terminate_date, terminate_reason, del_flag, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{status}, #{contractType}, #{signDate}, #{effectiveDate}, #{expireDate}, #{contractAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{paymentTerms}, #{deliveryTerms}, #{signBy}, #{signDepartment}, #{partyA}, #{partyB}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{changeCount}, #{terminateDate}, #{terminateReason}, #{delFlag}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_contract SET del_flag = '2' WHERE contract_id IN #{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT change_id, contract_id, change_no, change_type, field_name, new_value, change_content, original_content, change_reason, change_date, change_by, audit_by, audit_time, audit_status, audit_remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_contract_change WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY change_id DESC

mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_contract_change SET del_flag = '2' WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
